llm_response.reason: The website presents multiple hallmark scam characteristics: newly registered domain mismatched to claims of 7+ years trust; vague and unverifiable regulatory and company info; unrealistic investment returns and guaranteed profits across all investment types; fake or unverifiable awards; testimonials with unverifiable identities; excessive use of urgency and psychological manipulation; ambiguous privacy and contact details; an unverifiable company certificate. It mimics legitimate investment company language but lacks evidence and transparency. These details align directly with multiple listed Investment Scam properties.
